Percentage distribution of Violent IPC crimes during 2000-2002
During 2002, the percentage share of Violent Crimes reported in the country was 12.5 per cent of the total IPC
crimes. Such percentage share during 2000 and 2001 was at 13.5 percent and 13.1 percent respectively. Of the total
2,21,810 violent crimes reported during the year from the States and Union Territories, 44.2 per cent crimes were Violent
crimes affecting life (97,966 cases). Violent Crimes which affected the property during the period were 12.0 per cent
(26,706 cases); affecting the public safety were 36.4 per cent (80,765 cases) and Violent crimes directed against Women
3.2.2 The pattern of total Violent crimes during 1998-2002 reveal that except violent crime affecting women there has
been general decrease in the reported incidents of Violent crimes in the country
